title: Prethermal cooling with many-body quantum quenches
summary: Many-body quantum quenches are typically associated with heating. In this work, we show that quantum quenches that perform positive work on the system can still lead to effective cooling of low-energy degrees of freedom if the quench energy is deposited in long-lived high-energy excitations. We discuss this explicitly for a quench of the hopping term t in the strong-coupling (U >> t) fermionic Hubbard model at half filling, where the quench induces a very long-lived non-equilibrium doublon density.
